title.narrative: Leveraging Global Fund’s RSSH investments in DRC to contribute to the attainment of universal health coverage (UHC) and other health-related targets of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) - Congo (Democratic Republic) (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Congo (Democratic Republic), RSSH, Ministry of Public Health, Hygiene and Social Security (MOH DRC)This program has the following goals: Contribuer au bien-être de la population congolaise d’ici 2022 dans le cadre de la couverture sanitaire universelle et des autres cibles des objectifs de développement durable (ODD) / Contribute to the well-being of the Congolese population by 2022 as part of universal health coverage and other targets of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).. The objectives of this program are: Axe stratégique 1 : Amélioration des prestations des services de santé et continuité des soins / Strategic focus 1: Improving health service delivery and continuity of care.. Axe stratégique 2 : Appui aux piliers du système de santé pour améliorer la disponibilité et l’accessibilité de soins de qualité / Strategic focus 2: Support for the pillars of the health system to improve the availability and accessibility of quality care.. Axe stratégique 3 : Appui à la gouvernance, au leadership et au pilotage du système de santé / Strategic focus 3: Support for governance, leadership and management of the health system.

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for COD-S-MOHP02
HRH-other 1: Percentage of health workers benefiting from incentive bonus on time out of the expected number
Percent of district health management teams or other administrative units that have developed a monitoring plan, including annual work objectives and performance measures
Percentage of facilities that receive supportive supervision - at least once per quarter

M & E- other 2: Promptness of logistics reports from health facilities: Percentage of monthly logistics information reports expected from facilities (for the reporting period) that were received within 20 days after the end of the month
Timeliness of facility reporting: Percentage of submitted facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received

M & E-other 1: Completeness of logistics reports from health facilities: Percentage of monthly logistics information reports expected from facilities (for the reporting period) that have actually been received
SD other-1: Percentage of supervision pools that carried out quality supervision (according to standards and guidelines) during the year
Percentage of community based monitoring reports presented to relevant oversight mechanisms
Impact indicators targets and results for COD-S-MOHP02
TB I-other1:TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
TB/HIV I- other 1: TB/HIV mortality rate per 100,000 population
Malaria I-other 1: Reported malaria cases (presumed and confirmed)
HIV I-other 2: Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV from mother-to-child transmission among women living with HIV delivering in the past 12 months
HIV I- other 1: Number of AIDS related deaths per 100,000 population
Malaria I- other 2:In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
Outcome indicators targets and results for COD-S-MOHP02

National aggregate HMIS fully deployed and functional: Percentage of HMIS components in place (HIS deployment, completeness, timeliness, and integration of aggregate disease reporting for HIV, TB and malaria indicators)
Percentage of facilities providing diagnostic services on the day of the assessment
Percentage of health facilities with tracer medicines for the three diseases available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
